about: Popular newsletters with their homepage and, where it can be justified, their official feed URL. Edit freely. Every entry is verified: false until `npm run verify:catalog` (run from a GitHub runner) finds a valid feed at it; the agent that wrote these could not reach any of the sites. Discovery validates every feed live before storing it, so a wrong entry fails safely. feedUrl null means: discover from the homepage.

entries.name: TechCrunch
entries.note: Site-wide article feed (WordPress /feed/ convention), from memory, not checked. TechCrunch's email newsletters may not have feeds of their own.

entries.name: StrictlyVC
entries.note: No feed URL known for certain; discovery reads the homepage's advertised feed or tries /feed.

entries.name: Morning Brew
entries.note: No official RSS feed known; discovery will look. If none is found it needs the public web archive (a later Phase 1 item).

entries.name: Stratechery
entries.note: Public articles feed (WordPress /feed/ convention), from memory, not checked. Subscriber-only updates are not in it and are never fetched.

entries.name: Lenny's Newsletter
entries.note: Substack publication; Substack serves every publication's feed at /feed. Paid posts appear as previews and are marked partial.

entries.name: Platformer
entries.note: Ghost publication to the author's knowledge (Ghost serves /rss/), not checked. Paid posts are marked partial.

entries.name: The Pragmatic Engineer
entries.note: Substack publication (/feed convention), not checked. Many posts are paid and will be partial.

entries.name: Tomasz Tunguz
entries.note: Hugo site to the author's knowledge (Hugo serves /index.xml), not checked.

entries.name: Benedict Evans
entries.note: No feed URL known for certain; discovery reads the homepage. The weekly newsletter itself may only be email.

entries.name: The Generalist
entries.note: Host platform not known for certain; discovery reads the homepage and tries the common paths.

entries.name: Axios Pro Rata
entries.note: No per-newsletter feed known; discovery will look. Likely needs the public web archive (a later Phase 1 item).

entries.name: Term Sheet
entries.note: No per-newsletter feed known; discovery will look. May be partly paywalled; anything behind it is not read.
